verdict: Meta leads surging; Google spend is being cut until performance improves.
narrative: This period, Meta delivered all 35 of your paid leads at an average cost of $109.56 per lead across the full 28 days — and the most recent week alone saw lead volume double while cost per lead dropped 59%, a meaningful efficiency gain. Google Ads, by contrast, spent $2,016 this period and produced 1 confirmed conversion; that imbalance is being addressed now with spend actively pulled back 19% over the last seven days. On the pipeline side, 35 leads entered your system but no appointments or closed opportunities were recorded, which points to an intake gap rather than an advertising one — that process is being reviewed. Expect Google's allocation to continue tightening while Meta holds its current targeting approach, and pipeline follow-up steps to be tightened in the week ahead.
